     1→import pptxgen from 'pptxgenjs';

     8→// Photo dimensions in inches
     9→const SLIDE_MARGIN = 0.15;  // Reduced lateral margin
    10→const PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_W = 4.6;
    11→const PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H = 4.5;
    12→const PHOTO_PORTRAIT_W = 3.4;
    13→const PHOTO_PORTRAIT_H = 4.5;
    14→// Full-width dimensions for dual (side-by-side) photos
    15→const DUAL_PHOTO_W = 10 - SLIDE_MARGIN * 2;  // ~9.7"
    16→const DUAL_PHOTO_H = 4.5;

    18→// Sanitize text for use in filenames
    19→function sanitizeForFilename(text: string): string {
    20→  return text
    21→    .trim()
    22→    .substring(0, 60)
    23→    .replace(/[<>:"/\\|?*\x00-\x1f]/g, '')
    24→    .replace(/\s+/g, '_')
    25→    .replace(/_+/g, '_')
    26→    .replace(/^_|_$/g, '')
    27→    || 'Inspecao';
    28→}
    29→
    30→// Helper function to generate a black image with white text
    31→function generateSerialNumberImage(serialNumber: string): string {
    32→  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    33→  const width = 400;
    34→  const height = 400;
    35→  canvas.width = width;
    36→  canvas.height = height;
    37→  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    38→  
    39→  if (ctx) {
    40→    // Black background
    41→    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    42→    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    43→    
    44→    // White text
    45→    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
    46→    ctx.font = 'bold 48px Arial';
    47→    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    48→    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    49→    
    50→    // Draw serial number
    51→    const displayText = serialNumber || 'N/A';
    52→    ctx.fillText(displayText, width / 2, height / 2);
    53→  }
    54→  
    55→  return canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    56→}

    59→const LOGO_BASE64 = 'data:image/png;base64,';

    88→
    89→export async function generatePowerPoint(options: PowerPointOptions): Promise<void> {
    90→  const { inspection, photos, additionalParts, conclusion, language = 'pt', reportId, translatedData } = options;
    91→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
    92→  
    93→  // Use translated data if available, otherwise use original
    94→  const finalInspection = translatedData?.inspection || inspection;
    95→  const finalPhotos = translatedData?.photos || photos;
    96→  const finalConclusion = translatedData?.conclusion || conclusion;
    97→  
    98→  const pptx = new pptxgen();
    99→  
   100→  // Set presentation properties
   101→  pptx.author = 'Z-Services AI';
   102→  pptx.title = `Relatório Técnico - ${finalInspection.tag || 'Máquina'}`;
   103→  pptx.subject = finalInspection.descricao || 'Inspeção Técnica';
   104→  
   105→  // Generate slides
   106→  generateCoverSlide(pptx, finalInspection, language, reportId);
   107→  
   108→  // Slide de Identificação da Máquina (sempre gerado)
   109→  await generateMachineIdentificationSlide(pptx, finalInspection, language);
   110→  
   111→  await generatePhotoSlides(pptx, finalPhotos, language);
   112→  generatePartsTableSlides(pptx, finalPhotos, additionalParts, language);
   113→  
   114→  if (finalConclusion.trim()) {
   115→    generateConclusionSlide(pptx, finalConclusion, language);
   116→  }
   117→  
   118→  generateFinalSlide(pptx, language, reportId);
   119→  
   120→  // Save the file
   121→  const fileName = `Relatorio_${sanitizeForFilename(finalInspection.descricao || finalInspection.tag)}_${reportId || ''}_${formatDateForFileName(finalInspection.data)}.pptx`.replace(/__+/g, '_');
   122→  const blob = await pptx.write({ outputType: 'blob' }) as Blob;
   123→  saveAs(blob, fileName);
   124→}

   129→export async function generateHomePowerPoint(options: HomePowerPointOptions): Promise<void> {
   130→  const { inspection, categories, conclusion, language = 'pt', reportId, translatedData } = options;
   131→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   132→  
   133→  // Use translated data if available, otherwise use original
   134→  const finalInspection = translatedData?.inspection || inspection;
   135→  const finalCategories = translatedData?.categories || categories;
   136→  const finalConclusion = translatedData?.conclusion || conclusion;
   137→  
   138→  const pptx = new pptxgen();
   139→  
   140→  // Set presentation properties
   141→  pptx.author = 'Z-Services AI';
   142→  pptx.title = `Relatório Técnico - ${finalInspection.tag || 'Máquina'}`;
   143→  pptx.subject = finalInspection.descricao || 'Inspeção Técnica';
   144→  
   145→  // Generate slides
   146→  generateCoverSlide(pptx, finalInspection, language, reportId);
   147→  
   148→  // Slide de Identificação da Máquina (sempre gerado)
   149→  await generateMachineIdentificationSlide(pptx, finalInspection, language);
   150→  
   151→  // Generate category slides
   152→  for (const [index, category] of finalCategories.entries()) {
   153→    const photosWithImages = category.photos.filter(p => p.imageData);
   154→    if (photosWithImages.length > 0) {
   155→      await generateCategorySlides(pptx, category, index + 1, language);
   156→    }
   157→  }
   158→
   159→  // Collect all parts from all categories for the parts table
   160→  const allPhotos: PhotoData[] = [];
   161→  const allAdditionalParts: AdditionalPart[] = [];
   162→  finalCategories.forEach(category => {
   163→    allPhotos.push(...category.photos);
   164→    allAdditionalParts.push(...category.additionalParts);
   165→  });
   166→  
   167→  generatePartsTableSlides(pptx, allPhotos, allAdditionalParts, language);
   168→  
   169→  if (finalConclusion.trim()) {
   170→    generateConclusionSlide(pptx, finalConclusion, language);
   171→  }
   172→  
   173→  generateFinalSlide(pptx, language, reportId);
   174→  
   175→  // Save the file
   176→  const fileName = `Relatorio_Home_${sanitizeForFilename(finalInspection.descricao || finalInspection.tag)}_${reportId || ''}_${formatDateForFileName(finalInspection.data)}.pptx`.replace(/__+/g, '_');
   177→  const blob = await pptx.write({ outputType: 'blob' }) as Blob;
   178→  saveAs(blob, fileName);
   179→}

   181→// Helper function to get translated category title and description
   182→function getCategoryTranslation(categoryId: string, language: Language): { title: string; description: string } {
   183→  const titleKey = `category.${categoryId}`;
   184→  const descKey = `category.${categoryId}Desc`;
   185→  
   186→  return {
   187→    title: t(titleKey, language, { defaultValue: categoryId }),
   188→    description: t(descKey, language, { defaultValue: '' }),
   189→  };
   190→}

   192→/**
   193→ * Detect photo orientation and return appropriate PPT dimensions.
   194→ */
   195→async function getPhotoDimensions(photo: PhotoData): Promise<{ w: number; h: number; isPortrait: boolean }> {
   196→  const imgData = photo.editedImageData || photo.imageData;
   197→  if (!imgData) return { w: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_W, h: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H, isPortrait: false };
   198→  try {
   199→    const info = await getImageInfo(imgData);
   200→    return info.isPortrait
   201→      ? { w: PHOTO_PORTRAIT_W, h: PHOTO_PORTRAIT_H, isPortrait: true }
   202→      : { w: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_W, h: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H, isPortrait: false };
   203→  } catch {
   204→    return { w: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_W, h: PHOTO_LANDSCAPE_H, isPortrait: false };
   205→  }
   206→}
   207→
   208→/**
   209→ * Calculate x,y positions for 1 or 2 photos on a slide,
   210→ * centering them horizontally.
   211→ */
   212→function layoutPhotos(
   213→  dims1: { w: number; h: number } | null,
   214→  dims2: { w: number; h: number } | null,
   215→  y: number,
   216→  gap: number
   217→): Array<{ photo: PhotoData; x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number } | null> {
   218→  const result: Array<{ photo: PhotoData; x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number } | null> = [null, null];
   219→  
   220→  if (!dims1 && !dims2) return result;
   221→  
   222→  if (dims1 && !dims2) {
   223→    // Single photo: center it
   224→    result[0] = { photo: null!, x: (10 - dims1.w) / 2, y, w: dims1.w, h: dims1.h };
   225→    return result;
   226→  }
   227→  
   228→  if (dims1 && dims2) {
   229→    // Two photos: center them together
   230→    const totalW = dims1.w + gap + dims2.w;
   231→    const startX = (10 - totalW) / 2;
   232→    result[0] = { photo: null!, x: startX, y, w: dims1.w, h: dims1.h };
   233→    result[1] = { photo: null!, x: startX + dims1.w + gap, y, w: dims2.w, h: dims2.h };
   234→    return result;
   235→  }
   236→  
   237→  // Only dims2 (shouldn't happen)
   238→  result[1] = { photo: null!, x: (10 - dims2.w) / 2, y, w: dims2.w, h: dims2.h };
   239→  return result;
   240→}
   241→
   242→async function generateCategorySlides(
   243→  pptx: pptxgen, 
   244→  category: PhotoCategory, 
   245→  categoryNumber: number,
   246→  language: Language
   247→) {
   248→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   249→  const photosWithImages = category.photos.filter(p => p.imageData);
   250→  
   251→  // Get translated title
   252→  const { title: translatedTitle } = getCategoryTranslation(category.id, language);
   253→  
   254→  let photoRef = 0;
   255→  let i = 0;
   256→  
   257→  while (i < photosWithImages.length) {
   258→    const photo = photosWithImages[i];
   259→    const isDual = !!(photo.secondaryImageData && photo.imageData);
   260→    
   261→    if (isDual) {
   262→      // Dual photo gets its own full-width slide
   263→      photoRef++;
   264→      const slide = pptx.addSlide();
   265→      addCategoryHeader(slide, `${categoryNumber}. ${translatedTitle.toUpperCase()}`);
   266→      await addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo, SLIDE_MARGIN, 1.2, DUAL_PHOTO_W, DUAL_PHOTO_H, language, String(photoRef));
   267→      addStandardFooter(slide);
   268→      i++;
   269→    } else {
   270→      // Single photo - try to pair with next single photo
   271→      const nextPhoto = (i + 1 < photosWithImages.length && !photosWithImages[i + 1].secondaryImageData)
   272→        ? photosWithImages[i + 1]
   273→        : null;
   274→      
   275→      const slide = pptx.addSlide();
   276→      addCategoryHeader(slide, `${categoryNumber}. ${translatedTitle.toUpperCase()}`);
   277→      
   278→      // Photo 1
   279→      photoRef++;
   280→      const dims1 = await getPhotoDimensions(photo);
   281→      const pos1 = { x: (10 - dims1.w) / 2, y: 1.2, w: dims1.w, h: dims1.h };
   282→      await addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo, pos1.x, pos1.y, pos1.w, pos1.h, language, String(photoRef));
   283→      
   284→      // Photo 2 (if available)
   285→      if (nextPhoto) {
   286→        photoRef++;
   287→        const dims2 = await getPhotoDimensions(nextPhoto);
   288→        const positions = layoutPhotos(dims1, dims2, 1.2, 0.2);
   289→        await addPhotoToSlide(slide, nextPhoto, positions[1].x, positions[1].y, positions[1].w, positions[1].h, language, String(photoRef));
   290→        i += 2;
   291→      } else {
   292→        i++;
   293→      }
   294→      
   295→      addStandardFooter(slide);
   296→    }
   297→  }
   298→}

   475→async function generateMachineIdentificationSlide(pptx: pptxgen, inspection: InspectionData, language: Language) {
   476→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   477→  const slide = pptx.addSlide();
   478→  addStandardHeader(slide, isTranslated ? 'MACHINE IDENTIFICATION' : 'IDENTIFICAÇÃO DA MÁQUINA');
   479→  
   480→  // Title
   481→  slide.addText(isTranslated ? 'Machine Identification' : 'Identificação da Máquina', {
   482→    x: 0.3,
   483→    y: 1.1,
   484→    w: 9.4,
   485→    h: 0.4,
   486→    fontSize: 16,
   487→    bold: true,
   488→    color: '000000',
   489→    fontFace: 'Arial',
   490→    align: 'center',
   491→  });
   492→  
   493→  // Photo positions (4 columns) - centered on slide
   494→  const photoWidth = 2.1;
   495→  const photoHeight = 2.1;
   496→  const gap = 0.3;
   497→  const totalWidth = (photoWidth * 4) + (gap * 3);
   498→  const startX = (10 - totalWidth) / 2; // Center the photo group
   499→  const photoY = 1.7;
   500→  
   501→  // Photo 1: Equipamento
   502→  const photo1X = startX;
   503→  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
   504→    x: photo1X,
   505→    y: photoY,
   506→    w: photoWidth,
   507→    h: photoHeight,
   508→    fill: { color: 'F5F5F5' },
   509→    line: { color: 'CCCCCC', width: 2, dashType: 'dash' },
   510→  });
   511→  
   512→  if (inspection.machinePhoto) {
   513→    const processed = await maybeCoverCropImage(inspection.machinePhoto, { targetW: photoWidth, targetH: photoHeight });
   514→    slide.addImage({
   515→      data: processed,
   516→      x: photo1X,
   517→      y: photoY,
   518→      w: photoWidth,
   519→      h: photoHeight,
   520→    });
   521→  } else {
   522→    // Placeholder with camera icon
   523→    slide.addText('📷', {
   524→      x: photo1X,
   525→      y: photoY + photoHeight / 2 - 0.4,
   526→      w: photoWidth,
   527→      h: 0.5,
   528→      fontSize: 24,
   529→      color: 'CCCCCC',
   530→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   531→      align: 'center',
   532→    });
   533→    slide.addText(isTranslated ? 'Equipment Photo' : 'Foto do Equipamento', {
   534→      x: photo1X,
   535→      y: photoY + photoHeight / 2 + 0.1,
   536→      w: photoWidth,
   537→      h: 0.35,
   538→      fontSize: 8,
   539→      color: '999999',
   540→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   541→      align: 'center',
   542→      italic: true,
   543→    });
   544→  }
   545→  
   546→  // Label 1: TAG
   547→  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
   548→    x: photo1X,
   549→    y: photoY + photoHeight,
   550→    w: photoWidth,
   551→    h: 0.4,
   552→    fill: { color: 'FF6600' },
   553→  });
   554→  slide.addText(inspection.tag || (isTranslated ? 'Equipment TAG' : 'TAG do Equipamento'), {
   555→    x: photo1X,
   556→    y: photoY + photoHeight + 0.03,
   557→    w: photoWidth,
   558→    h: 0.35,
   559→    fontSize: 9,
   560→    bold: true,
   561→    color: 'FFFFFF',
   562→    fontFace: 'Arial',
   563→    align: 'center',
   564→  });
   565→  
   566→  // Photo 2: Horímetro
   567→  const photo2X = startX + photoWidth + gap;
   568→  slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
   569→    x: photo2X,
   570→    y: photoY,
   571→    w: photoWidth,
   572→    h: photoHeight,
   573→    fill: { color: 'F5F5F5' },
   574→    line: { color: 'CCCCCC', width: 2, dashType: 'dash' },

   754→
   755→async function generatePhotoSlides(pptx: pptxgen, photos: PhotoData[], language: Language) {
   756→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   757→  const photosWithImages = photos.filter(p => p.imageData);
   758→  
   759→  let photoRef = 0;
   760→  let i = 0;
   761→  
   762→  while (i < photosWithImages.length) {
   763→    const photo = photosWithImages[i];
   764→    const isDual = !!(photo.secondaryImageData && photo.imageData);
   765→    
   766→    if (isDual) {
   767→      // Dual photo gets its own full-width slide
   768→      photoRef++;
   769→      const slide = pptx.addSlide();
   770→      addStandardHeader(slide, isTranslated ? 'PHOTOS' : 'FOTOS');
   771→      await addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo, SLIDE_MARGIN, 1.2, DUAL_PHOTO_W, DUAL_PHOTO_H, language, String(photoRef));
   772→      addStandardFooter(slide);
   773→      i++;
   774→    } else {
   775→      // Single photo - try to pair with next single photo
   776→      const nextPhoto = (i + 1 < photosWithImages.length && !photosWithImages[i + 1].secondaryImageData)
   777→        ? photosWithImages[i + 1]
   778→        : null;
   779→      
   780→      const slide = pptx.addSlide();
   781→      addStandardHeader(slide, isTranslated ? 'PHOTOS' : 'FOTOS');
   782→      
   783→      // Photo 1
   784→      photoRef++;
   785→      const dims1 = await getPhotoDimensions(photo);
   786→      const pos1 = { x: (10 - dims1.w) / 2, y: 1.2, w: dims1.w, h: dims1.h };
   787→      await addPhotoToSlide(slide, photo, pos1.x, pos1.y, pos1.w, pos1.h, language, String(photoRef));
   788→      
   789→      // Photo 2 (if available)
   790→      if (nextPhoto) {
   791→        photoRef++;
   792→        const dims2 = await getPhotoDimensions(nextPhoto);
   793→        const positions = layoutPhotos(dims1, dims2, 1.2, 0.2);
   794→        await addPhotoToSlide(slide, nextPhoto, positions[1].x, positions[1].y, positions[1].w, positions[1].h, language, String(photoRef));
   795→        i += 2;
   796→      } else {
   797→        i++;
   798→      }
   799→      
   800→      addStandardFooter(slide);
   801→    }
   802→  }
   803→}
   804→
   805→async function addPhotoToSlide(
   806→  slide: pptxgen.Slide, 
   807→  photo: PhotoData, 
   808→  x: number, 
   809→  y: number, 
   810→  w: number, 
   811→  h: number,
   812→  language: Language,
   813→  photoRef: string
   814→) {
   815→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   816→  
   817→  // Check if we have a secondary photo (two photos side by side)
   818→  const hasSecondaryPhoto = photo.secondaryImageData && photo.imageData;
   819→  
   820→  // Calculate photo widths
   821→  const photoWidth = hasSecondaryPhoto ? (w - 0.1) / 2 : w;
   822→  
   823→  // Photo info overlay (if PN exists)
   824→  if (photo.pn) {
   825→    slide.addShape(slide._slideLayout?._presLayout?.pptx?.ShapeType?.rect || 'rect', {
   826→      x: x,
   827→      y: y - 0.4,
   828→      w: w,
   829→      h: 0.35,
   830→      fill: { color: '000000', transparency: 70 },
   831→    });
   832→    
   833→    let infoText = `${isTranslated ? 'Part Number:' : 'Numero da Peça:'} ${photo.pn}`;
   834→    if (photo.partName) infoText += ` ${photo.partName}`;
   835→    if (photo.quantity) infoText += ` ${isTranslated ? 'Qty:' : 'Qtd:'} ${photo.quantity}`;
   836→    
   837→    slide.addText(infoText, {
   838→      x: x + 0.1,
   839→      y: y - 0.35,
   840→      w: w - 0.2,
   841→      h: 0.25,
   842→      fontSize: 9,
   843→      color: 'FFFFFF',
   844→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   845→    });
   846→  }
   847→  
   848→  // Primary Photo
   849→  if (photo.imageData) {
   850→    const processed = await maybeCoverCropImage(photo.editedImageData || photo.imageData, { targetW: photoWidth, targetH: h });
   851→    slide.addImage({
   852→      data: processed || '',
   853→      x: x,
   854→      y: y,
   855→      w: photoWidth,
   856→      h: h,
   857→    });
   858→  }
   859→  
   860→  // Secondary Photo (lado a lado)
   861→  if (photo.secondaryImageData) {
   862→    const secondX = hasSecondaryPhoto ? x + photoWidth + 0.1 : x;
   863→    const secondW = hasSecondaryPhoto ? photoWidth : w;
   864→    const processed = await maybeCoverCropImage(photo.secondaryImageData, { targetW: secondW, targetH: h });
   865→    slide.addImage({
   866→      data: processed,
   867→      x: secondX,
   868→      y: y,
   869→      w: secondW,
   870→      h: h,
   871→    });
   872→  }
   873→  
   874→  // Photo reference badge
   875→  const refLabel = isTranslated ? `Photo ${photoRef}` : `Foto ${photoRef}`;
   876→  slide.addShape(slide._slideLayout?._presLayout?.pptx?.ShapeType?.rect || 'rect', {
   877→    x: x + 0.08,
   878→    y: y + h - 0.38,
   879→    w: 0.7,
   880→    h: 0.3,
   881→    fill: { color: '000000', transparency: 40 },
   882→    rectRadius: 0.04,
   883→  });
   884→  slide.addText(refLabel, {
   885→    x: x + 0.08,
   886→    y: y + h - 0.38,
   887→    w: 0.7,
   888→    h: 0.3,
   889→    fontSize: 8,
   890→    color: 'FFFFFF',
   891→    fontFace: 'Arial',
   892→    bold: true,
   893→    align: 'center',
   894→    valign: 'middle',
   895→  });
   896→
   897→  // Description
   898→  if (photo.description) {
   899→    slide.addShape(slide._slideLayout?._presLayout?.pptx?.ShapeType?.rect || 'rect', {
   900→      x: x,
   901→      y: y + h,
   902→      w: w,
   903→      h: 0.6,
   904→      fill: { color: 'FF6600' },
   905→    });
   906→    
   907→    slide.addText(photo.description.substring(0, 150), {
   908→      x: x + 0.1,
   909→      y: y + h + 0.05,
   910→      w: w - 0.2,
   911→      h: 0.5,
   912→      fontSize: 8,
   913→      color: 'FFFFFF',
   914→      fontFace: 'Arial',
   915→    });
   916→  }
   917→}
   918→
   919→// Interface for hierarchical parts structure
   920→interface PartRow {
   921→  pn: string;
   922→  serialNumber: string;
   923→  partName: string;
   924→  quantity: string;
   925→  isSubPart: boolean;
   926→  parentPn?: string;
   927→  indent: number;
   928→  photoRef?: string;
   929→}
   930→
   931→function generatePartsTableSlides(
   932→  pptx: pptxgen, 
   933→  photos: PhotoData[], 
   934→  additionalParts: AdditionalPart[],
   935→  language: Language
   936→) {
   937→  const isTranslated = language !== 'pt';
   938→  // Build photo ref maps (same numbering as generatePhotoSlides)
   939→  const photosWithImages = photos.filter(p => p.imageData);
   940→  const photoRefMap = new Map<string, string>();   // PN → photo number
   941→  const photoIdRefMap = new Map<string, string>();  // photo ID → photo number
   942→  photosWithImages.forEach((p, idx) => {
   943→    if (p.pn) photoRefMap.set(p.pn, String(idx + 1));
   944→    photoIdRefMap.set(p.id, String(idx + 1));
   945→  });
   946→
   947→  // Build hierarchical parts structure
   948→  const partRows: PartRow[] = [];
   949→  
   950→  // Process each photo that should be in the table (has PN or has sub-parts)
   951→  photos
   952→    .filter(p => photoShouldBeInPartsTable(p, additionalParts))
   953→    .forEach(photo => {
   954→      const displayPn = getDisplayPn(photo, additionalParts);
   955→      const photoRef = photo.pn
   956→        ? photoRefMap.get(photo.pn)
   957→        : photoIdRefMap.get(photo.id);
   958→      
   959→      // Add main part
   960→      partRows.push({
   961→        pn: displayPn,
   962→        serialNumber: photo.serialNumber || '',
   963→        partName: photo.partName || '-',
   964→        quantity: photo.quantity || '-',
   965→        isSubPart: false,
   966→        indent: 0,
   967→        photoRef,
   968→      });
   969→      
   970→      // Find and add all sub-parts for this photo
   971→      const subParts = getSubPartsForPhoto(photo, additionalParts);
   972→      subParts.forEach(subPart => {
   973→        partRows.push({
   974→          pn: subPart.pn,
   975→          serialNumber: subPart.serialNumber || '',
   976→          partName: subPart.partName,
   977→          quantity: subPart.quantity,
   978→          isSubPart: true,
   979→          parentPn: displayPn,
   980→          indent: 1,
   981→          photoRef,
   982→        });
   983→      });
   984→    });
   985→  
   986→  if (partRows.length === 0) return;
   987→  
   988→  // Calculate slides needed (8 rows per slide - peças principais + sub-peças)
   989→  const rowsPerSlide = 8;
   990→  const slidesNeeded = Math.ceil(partRows.length / rowsPerSlide);
   991→  
   992→  for (let slideIndex = 0; slideIndex < slidesNeeded; slideIndex++) {
   993→    const slide = pptx.addSlide();
   994→    addStandardHeader(slide, isTranslated ? 'PARTS TABLE' : 'TABELA DE PEÇAS');
   995→    
   996→    // Table title with page indicator if multiple slides
   997→    const titleText = slidesNeeded > 1 
   998→      ? `${isTranslated ? 'Parts Table' : 'Tabela de Peças'} (${slideIndex + 1}/${slidesNeeded})`
   999→      : (isTranslated ? 'Parts Table (Part Number)' : 'Tabela de Peças (Numero da Peça)');
  1000→    
  1001→    slide.addText(titleText, {
  1002→      x: 0.5,
  1003→      y: 1.2,
  1004→      w: 8,
  1005→      h: 0.4,
  1006→      fontSize: 14,
  1007→      bold: true,
  1008→      color: '000000',
  1009→      fontFace: 'Arial',
  1010→    });
  1011→    
  1012→    // Table header
  1013→    const headerY = 1.7;
  1014→    slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
  1015→      x: 0.5,
  1016→      y: headerY,
  1017→      w: 9,
  1018→      h: 0.4,
  1019→      fill: { color: '000000' },
  1020→    });
  1021→    
  1022→    const headers = [
  1023→      { text: isTranslated ? 'Ref' : 'Ref', x: 0.5, w: 0.6 },
  1024→      { text: isTranslated ? 'PN (Serial)' : 'PN (Serial)', x: 1.1, w: 2.2 },
  1025→      { text: isTranslated ? 'Part Name' : 'Nome da Peça', x: 3.3, w: 2.6 },
  1026→      { text: isTranslated ? 'Qty' : 'Qtd', x: 5.9, w: 1 },
  1027→      { text: isTranslated ? 'Type' : 'Tipo', x: 6.9, w: 2.6 },
  1028→    ];
  1029→    
  1030→    headers.forEach(header => {
  1031→      slide.addText(header.text, {
  1032→        x: header.x,
  1033→        y: headerY + 0.05,
  1034→        w: header.w,
  1035→        h: 0.3,
  1036→        fontSize: 10,
  1037→        bold: true,
  1038→        color: 'FFFFFF',
  1039→        fontFace: 'Arial',
  1040→        align: 'center',
  1041→      });
  1042→    });
  1043→    
  1044→    // Table rows
  1045→    const startIdx = slideIndex * rowsPerSlide;
  1046→    const endIdx = Math.min(startIdx + rowsPerSlide, partRows.length);
  1047→    const slideParts = partRows.slice(startIdx, endIdx);
  1048→    
  1049→    let rowY = headerY + 0.4;
  1050→    const rowHeight = 0.35;
  1051→    
  1052→    slideParts.forEach((part, idx) => {
  1053→      // Row background - different colors for main and sub-parts
  1054→      const bgColor = part.isSubPart ? 'FFF5E6' : (idx % 2 === 0 ? 'F8F9FA' : 'FFFFFF');
  1055→      slide.addShape(pptx.ShapeType.rect, {
  1056→        x: 0.5,
  1057→        y: rowY,
  1058→        w: 9,
  1059→        h: rowHeight,
  1060→        fill: { color: bgColor },
  1061→        line: part.isSubPart ? { color: 'FFE0B2', width: 0.5 } : undefined,
  1062→      });
  1063→      
  1064→      // Ref column (Foto X)
  1065→      const refText = part.photoRef 
  1066→        ? (isTranslated ? `Photo ${part.photoRef}` : `Foto ${part.photoRef}`)
  1067→        : '-';
  1068→      slide.addText(refText, {
  1069→        x: 0.5,
  1070→        y: rowY + 0.05,
  1071→        w: 0.6,
  1072→        h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1073→        fontSize: part.isSubPart ? 8 : 9,
  1074→        color: part.photoRef ? 'FF6600' : '999999',
  1075→        fontFace: 'Arial',
  1076→        align: 'center',
  1077→        valign: 'middle',
  1078→        bold: !!part.photoRef,
  1079→      });
  1080→
  1081→      // Sub-part indicator (arrow or dash)
  1082→      if (part.isSubPart) {
  1083→        slide.addText('└─', {
  1084→          x: 1.1,
  1085→          y: rowY + 0.05,
  1086→          w: 0.3,
  1087→          h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1088→          fontSize: 9,
  1089→          color: 'FF6600',
  1090→          fontFace: 'Arial',
  1091→          align: 'center',
  1092→          valign: 'middle',
  1093→        });
  1094→      }
  1095→      
  1096→      // Part Number with Serial (with indent for sub-parts)
  1097→      const pnX = part.isSubPart ? 1.35 : 1.1;
  1098→      const pnText = part.serialNumber 
  1099→        ? `${part.pn} (${part.serialNumber})`
  1100→        : part.pn;
  1101→      slide.addText(pnText, {
  1102→        x: pnX,
  1103→        y: rowY + 0.05,
  1104→        w: part.isSubPart ? 1.95 : 2.2,
  1105→        h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1106→        fontSize: part.isSubPart ? 8 : 9,
  1107→        color: part.isSubPart ? 'CC5200' : '000000',
  1108→        fontFace: 'Arial',
  1109→        align: 'center',
  1110→        valign: 'middle',
  1111→        italic: part.isSubPart,
  1112→      });
  1113→      
  1114→      // Part Name
  1115→      slide.addText(part.partName, {
  1116→        x: 3.3,
  1117→        y: rowY + 0.05,
  1118→        w: 2.6,
  1119→        h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1120→        fontSize: part.isSubPart ? 8 : 9,
  1121→        color: part.isSubPart ? '666666' : '000000',
  1122→        fontFace: 'Arial',
  1123→        align: 'center',
  1124→        valign: 'middle',
  1125→        italic: part.isSubPart,
  1126→      });
  1127→      
  1128→      // Quantity
  1129→      slide.addText(part.quantity, {
  1130→        x: 5.9,
  1131→        y: rowY + 0.05,
  1132→        w: 1,
  1133→        h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1134→        fontSize: part.isSubPart ? 8 : 9,
  1135→        color: '000000',
  1136→        fontFace: 'Arial',
  1137→        align: 'center',
  1138→        valign: 'middle',
  1139→      });
  1140→      
  1141→      // Type column
  1142→      const typeText = part.isSubPart 
  1143→        ? (isTranslated ? '↳ Sub-part' : '↳ Sub-peça')
  1144→        : (isTranslated ? 'Main' : 'Principal');
  1145→      
  1146→      slide.addText(typeText, {
  1147→        x: 6.9,
  1148→        y: rowY + 0.05,
  1149→        w: 2.6,
  1150→        h: rowHeight - 0.1,
  1151→        fontSize: part.isSubPart ? 8 : 9,
  1152→        color: part.isSubPart ? 'FF6600' : '000000',
  1153→        fontFace: 'Arial',
  1154→        align: 'center',
  1155→        valign: 'middle',
  1156→        italic: part.isSubPart,
  1157→      });
  1158→      
  1159→      rowY += rowHeight;
  1160→    });
  1161→    
  1162→    addStandardFooter(slide);
  1163→  }
  1164→}

  1166→function generateConclusionSlide(pptx: pptxgen, conclusion: string, language: Language) {

  1378→function formatDateForFileName(dateString: string): string {
  1379→  if (!dateString) return new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
  1380→  
  1381→  // Parse date manually to avoid timezone issues
  1382→  const parts = dateString.split('-');
  1383→  if (parts.length === 3) {
  1384→    const day = parts[2].padStart(2, '0');
  1385→    const month = parts[1].padStart(2, '0');
  1386→    const year = parts[0];
  1387→    return `${day}-${month}-${year}`;
  1388→  }
  1389→  
  1390→  // Fallback: use current date
  1391→  const today = new Date();
  1392→  const day = String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  1393→  const month = String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  1394→  const year = today.getFullYear();
  1395→  return `${day}-${month}-${year}`;
  1396→}
  1397→
  1398→function formatDateForDisplay(dateString: string): string {
  1399→  if (!dateString) return '';
  1400→  
  1401→  // Parse date manually to avoid timezone issues (YYYY-MM-DD format)
  1402→  const parts = dateString.split('-');
  1403→  if (parts.length === 3) {
  1404→    const day = parts[2].padStart(2, '0');
  1405→    const month = parts[1].padStart(2, '0');
  1406→    const year = parts[0];
  1407→    return `${day}/${month}/${year}`;
  1408→  }
  1409→  
  1410→  return dateString;
  1411→}
